correctness.rationale: Homma’s complete smoothness/classification theorem reduces to eight irreducible cubic representatives in two affine orbits. Independently checked finite-field residues and exact double sums yield the first six point counts for all eight curves. Newton identities and genus-six Weil duality determine all coefficients; irreducibility certificates modulo two establish the asserted simple isogeny factors. The exact artifact source paths were inspected and both verifiers executed successfully.

value.rationale: This is a complete Frobenius classification of the natural extremal minimum-degree plane-filling quintics over \(\mathbb F_3\), with a meaningful sharp dichotomy between simple genus-six Jacobians and triples of ordinary simple abelian surfaces. The precise zeta polynomials settle all extension-field point counts and go beyond the known geometric and ordinarity classifications.
